messages:
Priya: Quick follow-up from the KV-cache postmortem. We need concrete owners + short timelines for the remediation items (profiling, evasive GC, eviction policy, and customer mitigations). Calling accountability so we don't drift.

Alex: I can lead the allocation/profiler work. Plan: run heap profiles across canary load patterns, produce a tl;dr + repro scripts. ETA: Thursday COB.

Chen: I'll take eviction/LRU tuning and a small soft-cap on prefix sizes. Will prototype a graded cap (64k->32k fallback) and measure miss rate impact. ETA: next Wed.

Marta: I'll do observability: add ghost_allocs gauge, per-shard free-lag histogram, and OOM-incident alert thresholds. Draft dashboards by Tuesday.

Leo: I'll own the runtime hard-limit flag and emergency-mode rollback (hotkey). I'll also add a temporary circuit-breaker that marks a node read-only if mem > 90% for 60s. PR by Monday.

Priya: Good. Please include test plan lines so SRE can validate in staging (load scripts, expected metrics).

Alex: Sampling note: used `gperftools` heap-profiler plus 30s pmap snapshots. Command: `HEAPPROFILE=/tmp/heap ./kvnode --load-sim` and `pprof --text` for hot-spot traces. Will include exact commands.

Chen: For eviction, I'm thinking adaptive LRU where large prefixes have higher eviction score. If that fails, we'll try a hard soft-cap with eviction hint.

Marta: Alerting thresholds proposal:
- warn: ghost_alloc_rate > 5/min
- critical: OOM_count > 0 within 10 minutes or mem_usage > 92% for 2 minutes
We'll also add runbook links to the alert.

Leo: Canary rollout plan: 2 nodes -> 10% traffic -> 50% -> full. Automatic rollback on OOM or 95th latency regressions > 15%. Canary window 30m each step.

Priya: Customers: for known impacted tenants, we'll prepare an advisory template (temporary request throttling + read-only fallback). Who owns comms?

Marta: I'll coordinate with Support on the advisory draft and include a short FAQ for platform teams.

Alex: Found a reproducible sequence: long-lived prefix + rapid updates spikes memory usage; repro script attached to my branch `repro/prefix-growth-1852`.

Chen: If prefix growth is the vector, a per-prefix write-rate limiter might help. I'll prototype a simple token-bucket limiter per prefix in the loader.

Leo: I've added a feature flag: `--kv-emergency-mode` which toggles the circuit-breaker behaviors. We'll gate by config so we can flip quickly in prod. PR ID: 4921.

OpsBot: Reminder: add all owners to the postmortem board card. Format: owner / task / ETA / rollback risk.

Priya: Action summary and owners:
- Alex: profiling + repro scripts (ETA Thu COB)
- Chen: eviction & prefix cap prototype (ETA Wed)
- Marta: metrics + alerting + customer advisory draft (ETA Tue)
- Leo: emergency-mode flag + circuit-breaker + PR (ETA Mon)
- Priya: coordinate staging validation + schedule weekly check-ins (ETA today)

Priya: I'll lock these on the postmortem board and create a 20m check-in on Thursday 09:30 to validate early outputs. If any ETA slips, ping the board card.

Alex: Posting initial heap snapshots to the postmortem doc now.

Chen: Starting eviction prototype, will run locally against Alex's repro script.

Marta: Dashboard PR opened: `obs/kv-ghosts` with draft panels. Need someone to sanity-check alerts.

Leo: PR for emergency-mode is up; marking it internal until tests pass.

Priya: Thanks team. OpsBot can you create the card in the postmortem board and set the check-in calendar?

OpsBot: Card created: "KV-cache memory remediation". Check-in invite: Thu 09:30 (20m).

Priya: Perfect 10 I'll send a short summary email to eng-runtime and support after this thread. Keep updates on the board.

Marta: One more note: include OOM reproduction steps and a short snippet for support to run in customer environments (sanitized).

Alex: Will add repro instructions + pprof outputs.

Chen: If we see fragmentation-heavy patterns in the heap, I may recommend a compact-on-idle pass; will report after initial run.

Priya: Great. Closing thread for now; see you on Thursday.
